description_en: Executes an SQL statement synchronously on a specified database via OpenAPI and returns the result
description_zh: 通过OpenAPI在指定数据库上同步执行SQL语句并返回结果
kebab_example: aliyun hologram execute-statement --instance-id hgprecn-cn-i7m2ucpyu005 --db-name test_db --sql select_0_from_test_table_limit_10 --parameters '["test_val"]' --max-rows 300 --max-bytes 1024 --query-timeout 5 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecuteStatement

parameters.help_en: The maximum size of the response, in bytes. Default: 10,485,760 (10 MB). If the response size exceeds this limit, it is truncated, as indicated by the Truncated field in the response
parameters.help_zh: 单次返回的最大数据量（字节）。默认 10485760（10 MB），超出时截断并标记 truncated=true
parameters.name: max_bytes

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of rows to return. Default: 200. Maximum: 1,000. If the result set exceeds this limit, it is truncated, as indicated by the `Truncated` field in the response
parameters.help_zh: 最大返回行数，默认 200，最大值 1000。超出部分截断并在响应中通过 `Truncated` 字段标识
parameters.name: max_rows

parameters.help_en: An array of bound parameters for a parameterized query. These parameters map sequentially to placeholders (e.g., `$1`, `$2`) in the SQL statement. Supported types include `String`, `Long`, `Double`, `Boolean`, and `null` (for SQL `NULL`). Using parameterized queries helps prevent SQL injection and improves the cache reuse rate for prepared statements. These parameters apply to all SQL statements in the sql field
parameters.help_zh: SQL 参数化查询的绑定参数列表，与 SQL 中的 `$1`, `$2`, ... 占位符按顺序对应。支持的值类型包括：`String`、`Long`、`Double`、`Boolean` 和 `null`（表示 `NULL`）。使用参数化查询可有效防止 SQL 注入，并提升预编译语句的缓存复用率。参数列表作用于 `Statements` 中的每条 SQL
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.help_en: The query timeout, in seconds. Default: 30. Maximum: 30. Minimum: 1. If a query exceeds this time limit, the server cancels it
parameters.help_zh: SQL 执行超时时间（秒）。默认 30，最大 30，最小 1。超时后服务端主动取消查询
parameters.name: query_timeout

parameters.help_en: The SQL statement to execute. The maximum length is 16,384 characters. You can specify multiple SQL statements separated by semicolons. If multiple statements are provided, the API returns the result of the last statement
parameters.help_zh: 待执行的 SQL 语句，最大长度 16384 字符。支持多条 SQL 以分号分隔，多条时返回最后一条语句的结果
parameters.name: sql

data.description_en: The execution result of the SQL statement
data.description_zh: true:允许OpenAPI SQL执行调用；false：未允许OpenAPI SQL执行调用

errorCode.description_en: The error code for the SQL statement execution. This parameter is returned only if the execution fails

errorMessage.description_en: The error message for the SQL statement execution. This parameter is returned only if the execution fails
errorMessage.example: 参数值不合法（如 SQL 为空、超长等）

results.description_en: A list of execution results. This list always contains exactly one result object. If you execute multiple SELECT statements, only the result of the last one is returned
results.description_zh: 执行结果列表，当前固定长度为 1。多条select查询的结果只返回最后一条select

items.description_en: An object that contains the result of a single SQL statement

columnMetadata.description_en: The metadata of columns in the result set

nullable.description_en: Indicates whether the column can be null

type.description_en: The data type of the column, such as `int4`, `text`, or `bool`

count.description_en: The number of rows returned by a SELECT statement

errorCode.description_en: The error code for the SQL statement
errorCode.description_zh: 该条 SQL 的错误码

errorMessage.description_en: The error message for the SQL statement
errorMessage.description_zh: 该条 SQL 的错误信息
errorMessage.example: ERROR: relation \"non_existent_table\" does not exist\n  Position: 15

records.description_en: The set of records that are returned by the query. Each row is an array of strings, and all values are serialized as strings. A NULL value is represented as "\N"
records.description_zh: 查询结果行集合。每行为一个字符串数组，所有值序列化为 String，NULL 值表示为 "\N"

items.description_en: An array that represents a single row in the result set
A field value, returned as a string

sql.description_zh: 实际执行的 SQL 语句

success.description_en: Indicates whether the SQL statement was executed successfully

truncated.description_en: Indicates whether the result set was truncated. The value is `true` if the number of returned rows exceeds the value of `MaxResults`
truncated.description_zh: 结果是否被截断（超过 `MaxResults` 时为 `true`）

updateCount.description_en: The number of rows affected by an INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE statement. This parameter is not returned for SELECT statements

success.description_en: Indicates whether the SQL statement was executed successfully

errorCode.description_en: The error code. This parameter is returned only if the request fails

errorMessage.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned only if the request fails
errorMessage.example: 参数值不合法（如 SQL 为空、超长等）

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
